from sqlfmt.api import format_string
from sqlfmt.mode import Mode
from sqlfmt.ddl import parse_ddl_table
s = 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t (id INT NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2), CHECK (id > 0), PRIMARY KEY (id));'
r = format_string(s, Mode())
assert r == 'create table if not exists t (\n    id int not null,\n    amount decimal(10, 2),\n    check (id > 0),\n    primary key (id)\n)\n;\n'
assert format_string(r, Mode()) == r
t = parse_ddl_table(Mode().dialect.initialize_analyzer(line_length=88).parse_query(s).lines)
assert t and t.column_count == 2 and t.constraint_count == 2 and t.columns[1].type_name == 'decimal(10,2)'
print('DDL formatting and parsing checks passed')
